newsitem.title: LATVIA: Gaz de France eyes Latvian gas sell-off.
newsitem.headline: Gaz de France eyes Latvian gas sell-off.

text.p: French state-owned utility Gaz de France would be interested in taking part in the privatisation of Latvia's national gas company, the economy ministry quoted a Gaz de France vice-president as saying on Wednesday.

"Gaz de France maintains its interest in co-operation with both Latvia and other Baltic states and would happily take part in the privatisation of Latvian Gas," an economy ministry statement quoted Gaz de France vice-president George Donard as saying during a meeting with Economy Minister Guntar Krasts.
Donard was on a visit to the ministry and talked about the situation in the energy sector and the pace of privatisation.
The Latvian government has already agreed to sell around a 30 percent stake in Latvian Gas to a consortium of Preussen and Ruhrgas as well as Russsia's Gazprom.
However, the German companies have delayed signing a final deal as they want the government to take over the gas firm's large debts.
The Latvian privatisation agency has said it hopes to sign a final deal with Ruhrgas and Preussen in February.
